svg.title: S6.2 · The deploy that created nothing: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 19: visitor (asks every 2 s,, prints a result); Service dashboard (one stable address); Pod dashboard (Homer, hackathon team links). Also: ResourceQuota (hackathon-quota, the team budget). Your mission: The deploy succeeded. Where are the Pods?
